headline: Airport arrest: Accused in Salman Shah murder case arrested in Dhaka
summary: Mohammad Ashraful Haque, known as Don, was detained at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport while attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia.
details: Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today. He was later handed over to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) for further questioning.

The arrest occurred around 6:00 am as Ashraful was attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah. Police had previously issued a requisition to airport authorities to prevent the accused from leaving the country.
The murder case was filed with the Ramna Police Station. A court directive had also been issued to ensure the accused named in the first information report (FIR) did not flee the country.
Following the arrest, Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jewel Rana sent the accused to jail after police produced him before the court.
The case dates back to 1996, when popular actor Salman Shah (born Shahriar Chowdhury Emon) was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence in Dhaka on September 6 at the age of 25.
caption:
A man attempting to fly to Saudi Arabia was arrested at Dhaka airport today—he is an accused in the 1996 murder case of actor Salman Shah.

Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today. He was later handed over to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) for further questioning.

The arrest occurred around 6:00 am as Ashraful was attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah. Police had previously issued a requisition to airport authorities to prevent the accused from leaving the country.

The murder case was filed with the Ramna Police Station. A court directive had also been issued to ensure the accused named in the first information report (FIR) did not flee the country.

Following the arrest, Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jewel Rana sent the accused to jail after police produced him before the court.

The case dates back to 1996, when popular actor Salman Shah (born Shahriar Chowdhury Emon) was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence in Dhaka on September 6 at the age of 25.

headline: 672 hospitalised in 24 hours as 2 die of dengue
summary: The number of single-day hospitalisations has reached its highest point this year, according to the DGHS.
details: At least two dengue patients died and 672 others were hospitalised within a 24-hour period ending at 8:00am today.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), both deaths were reported from Dhaka South City Corporation.
The total number of dengue-related deaths has now risen to 61, while the total number of cases has reached 19,345.
Currently, 1,441 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.
